name: The Battle Bricks: RGB
desc:
Don't take this game too seriously, I made this as a joke and it will probably never be polished to be an actual game.

In this game, these battlers take advantage of the 3D space... and that's basically it. But, fear not because YOU can be a part of the battle! That's right, you got yourself some rifles and grenades, brother! Forgot those toy weapons, it's time for you to be a real man!
